vitality.healing.title: Rest & Natural Healing
vitality.healing.summary:
Short Rest (Post-Combat): Restores d4 Vit ❤️ (limit 1 per combat encounter) and steps up Focus 🎯 by +1d.
Full Rest (Sleep / New Day): Restores 2d4 Vit ❤️ and restores Focus 🎯 to its maximum size.

leveling.creation_steps.title: Character Creation Steps
leveling.creation_steps.summary:
1. Concept — Any hero idea works.
2. Paths (🧭) — Choose a Race Path and Class Path (plus automatic Innate & Universal Paths).
3. Attributes (✅) — Assign two 4, two 6, and one 8 across ✨💪👁️🏃🫀.
4. Vitality (❤️) — 10 + 1d(🫀) (reroll a 1 once at creation).
5. Focus (🎯) — Starts at d4.
6. Spend 8 Starting AP (🧩) — Unlock In-Path skills, weapons, armor, powers, and boons.
7. Dossier — Appearance, traits, flair, and quest.
8. Money & Gear — 5 Gold (g) + 50 Silver (s) after starting gear.
9. Starting Loot — 1 random Artifact 🔮 + 2 random Chaos Gems 💎.
10. Luck (🍀) — Begin each session with 3 Luck (max 5).

col.weapons.dmg.title: Damage (💥)
col.weapons.dmg.summary: Damage dealt on a successful hit. When you meet a weapon's Attribute requirement, single-attack damage uplifts to your governing Attribute die if higher.

col.weapons.range.title: Range (🎯)
col.weapons.range.summary: Effective targeting distance: Self, Touch, 1sq, 2sq, 3sq, Short (up to 6 sq), Medium (up to 12 sq), Long (up to 24 sq).

col.weapons.atr.title: Attribute (✅)
col.weapons.atr.summary: The Attribute governing rolls with this weapon: Might 💪 for Melee, Motion 🏃 for Hurled, and Mind 👁️ for Shot.

col.powers.usage.title: Usage Frequency (🔄)
col.powers.usage.summary: Standardized usage options: 1-⚡ (1 Bolt = 5 Sparks), 1-🍀 (1 Luck), 1-Enc, 2-Enc, 3-Enc, 1-Rnd.

col.powers.action.title: Action Cost (🔷)
col.powers.action.summary: Action channel required to activate: Attack (A), Move (M), Partial (P), Free (F), or Attack & Move (AM).

col.powers.duration.title: Duration (⏳)
col.powers.duration.summary: How long the effect lasts: Instant, This Rnd, 1 Rnd (default), Encounter, or Next … (triggers on next specified roll or event).

col.powers.range.title: Range (🎯)
col.powers.range.summary: Targeting distance: Self, Touch, 1sq, 2sq, 3sq, Short (up to 6 sq), Medium (up to 12 sq), Long (up to 24 sq).

col.powers.ap.title: AP Cost (🧩)
col.powers.ap.summary: Adventure Points required to unlock and learn this ability (1 AP In-Path, 3 AP Universal or Out-of-Path).

col.magic_items.category.title: Exotics, Mods & Artifacts (🧿)
col.magic_items.category.summary: Equipment lineage: ⭕ Free Inherent Ability (0 AP), 🧿 Exotic Power (1 AP), 🔮 Artifact (found treasure, 1 AP per power).

appendix.optional_rules.title: Appendix A · Optional Rules
appendix.optional_rules.summary:
• Damage Shift (Dmg Shift) — Shift excess Attack margin into +Dmg on d6–d12 weapons (up to +1/+2/+3/+4), or reverse-shift up to 4 Dmg into Attack on d4 weapons.
• 🚩 +1 Nish Reward — Beating all opponents on Initiative grants +1 to all rolls until opponents act.
• 🏹 Ranged Attack into Melee — Natural 1 on the d20 when firing into melee strikes an adjacent ally unless they Dodge or Block.
• 🎯 Extended Range (Ext Rng) — Attack one range band beyond normal max range at Disadvantage (2L20).

appendix.master_terminology.title: Appendix C · Glossary & Symbols
appendix.master_terminology.summary: Complete A–Z terminology glossary and canonical symbol lexicon for SupaFlex.

player.cheat_sheet.title: Appendix D · Quick Reference Sheet
player.cheat_sheet.summary: At-a-glance combat turn sequence, core rolls, defenses, and tactical reminders.

focus.basics.title: Focus Die Rules
focus.basics.summary:
Focus Roll:
• Spend Timing — Once per Ability roll (or Dmg, AR, Healing), after seeing the initial roll result, roll your current Focus Die and add the result directly to your total. Focus rolls explode and stack with everything.
• Step-Down Rule — Your Focus Die steps down by -1d whenever the Focus roll is neither its maximum face nor a 1 (d12 ➔ d10 ➔ d8 ➔ d6 ➔ d4 ➔ Exhausted). For example, on a d6, the die steps down on a roll of 2, 3, 4, or 5, but stays at d6 on a 1 or 6.
• Usage Limit — Limit 1 Focus spend per roll.

Refilling Focus:
• Start of Combat — Step up +1d at the beginning of an encounter.
• End of Combat — Step up +1d upon resolving an encounter.
• Short Rest — Step up +1d when taking a short rest opportunity between combats (limit 1 per combat encounter).
• Full Round Action (Flooding) — Spend an entire combat round taking no other actions to "Flood" (+1d step up).
• Full Rest — A full night's sleep completely restores your Focus Die to its maximum ceiling size.

leveling.advancement_steps.title: Leveling & AP Advancement
leveling.advancement_steps.summary:
Gain 2 AP per Level

Free Level Advancement:
• Free Max Vit Roll — At each new level, roll for a new Max Vit ❤️ (0 AP) and keep the higher of your old or new Max Vit.

Tier 1 · Basic Progression & Element Learning (1–4 AP):
• In-Path Elements — Learn Weapon, Armor, Shield, Skill, Power, or Trait (1 AP) | Learn Skill Set (2 AP).
• Unmet Item Requirements — Learn In-Path Weapon, Armor, or Shield before meeting its Attribute requirement (2 AP: +1 AP surcharge, functions at current stats, +1 AP refunded when met).
• Universal Path Elements — Learn any Universal Path ability without GM approval (3 AP).
• Out-of-Path Elements (GM Approval) — Learn Out-of-Path element meeting requirements (3 AP) | Out-of-Path Skill Set (4 AP) | Out-of-Path with unmet requirements (4 AP).
• Learn Bonus Path — Unlock an additional Path (4 AP + GM Approval). Automatically refunds Out-of-Path surcharges on owned abilities in that Path!
• Manage Vitality — Gain +2 Max Vit ❤️ (1 AP, refundable at any time).
• Power Versions — Upgrade a known Power or Exotic as a new Version along allowed vectors (Die type, Target Count, Bonus, Affliction, Usage, or Range; never Action) for (Version # - 1) AP with GM approval.

Tier 2 & 3 · Attribute, Focus & Capstone Upgrades (1–8 AP):
• Manage Attributes — Step-Up Attribute rating +2 (2–8 AP, level-gated) | Swap two Attribute ratings (1 AP).
• Upgrade Focus Die — Step-Up Max Focus Die ceiling (2–8 AP, level-gated).
• No AP Is Ever Lost — Unlearning any ability or meeting a requirement or Path later immediately refunds 100% of the invested or surcharge AP.

paths.basics.title: Paths & Character Progression
paths.basics.summary:
Foundational Paths:
• Starting Paths — Every hero starts with 2 selected Paths: a Race Path (🧬) and a Class Path (⚔️), plus automatic access to the Innate Path and Universal Path.
• In-Path Elements — Abilities (Weapons, Armor, Shields, Skills, Powers, Traits) in your active Paths cost 1 AP to learn (2 AP for Skill Sets).
• Universal Path — High-impact global abilities available to any hero for 3 AP without GM approval.
• Out-of-Path Surcharge — Learning an ability outside your active Paths costs 3 AP with GM approval (4 AP for Skill Sets).
• Bonus Paths & Refunds — Unlocking an additional Path costs 4 AP with GM approval and automatically refunds any Out-of-Path surcharges on abilities you already own in that Path.

traits.title: Traits & Inherent Capabilities
traits.summary:
Modular Capabilities & Inherent Traits:
• Inherent Traits (0 AP) — Free biological, physiological, or cultural traits granted by your starting Paths. Inherent traits are auto-taken and cannot be removed without GM approval.
• Learned Traits — Modular traits, physiological boons, and tactical capabilities learned with AP (1 AP In-Path, 3 AP Universal or Out-of-Path with GM approval).
• Sheet Visibility — Use the Pill Switch to toggle individual traits between Viewable (👁️) on your active character sheet or Hidden (🙈) for passive background rules.
• Affirmative Capabilities — All mechanical Traits represent affirmative capabilities or balanced trade-offs.

traits.basics.title: Traits & Inherent Capabilities
traits.basics.summary:
Modular Capabilities & Inherent Traits:
• Inherent Traits (0 AP) — Free biological, physiological, or cultural traits granted by your starting Paths. Inherent traits are auto-taken and cannot be removed without GM approval.
• Learned Traits — Modular traits, physiological boons, and tactical capabilities learned with AP (1 AP In-Path, 3 AP Universal or Out-of-Path with GM approval).
• Sheet Visibility — Use the Pill Switch to toggle individual traits between Viewable (👁️) on your active character sheet or Hidden (🙈) for passive background rules.
• Affirmative Capabilities — All mechanical Traits represent affirmative capabilities or balanced trade-offs.

vitality.death_checks.title: Vitality, Death Checks & Healing
vitality.death_checks.summary:
Unconsciousness & Dying:
• Affliction Order & Unified Triggers (Vit 0 or Below) — At Vit 0 or below, resolve in strict order: 1. Bleeding, 2. Death Check, 3. Unconscious Check. Triggered upon reaching Vit 0 or below, anytime more Wnds 🩸 are received, and on each of the character’s Nishes 🚩 starting next round (Bleeding does not apply upon first entering Vit 0 or below or when receiving more Wnds).
• 1. Bleeding (-1 Vit) — Suffer +1 Wound 🩸 (-1 Vit ❤️) on each of your Nishes starting next round until stabilized via First Aid, triage, or magical healing.
• 2. Death Check (Resist Death 🫀) — Skill check rolled at 🫀^-Vit+5 (for example, at Vit 0 it is 🫀^5; at Vit -8 it is 🫀^13).
• 3. Unconscious Check (Resist Unconsciousness 🫀) — Skill check rolled at 🫀^-Vit+10 (for example, at Vit 0 it is 🫀^10; at Vit -8 it is 🫀^18). Failure causes unconsciousness (collapse Prone, cannot take actions).

Rest & Recovery (Healing):
• Short Rest (Post-Combat) — A brief rest after battle restores d4 Vit ❤️ (limit 1 per combat encounter) and steps up Focus 🎯 by +1d.
• Full Rest (Sleep / New Day) — A full night's sleep restores 2d4 Vit ❤️ and restores Focus 🎯 to its maximum size.
• First Aid & Magical Healing — Medical supplies, bandaging, healing skills, and magical healing stop active bleeding.

movement_rate.basics.title: Movement Rate (MR 👣) & Jumping Rules
movement_rate.basics.summary:
Tactical Movement:
• Standard Move (M Action) — Move up to your full Movement Rate (MR 👣) in squares (1 sq = 5 ft).
• Running / Sprinting (AM Action) — Running requires an Attack & Move (AM) action and grants full ground movement of MR 👣 + d👣 squares (👣+d👣 sq). All d👣 rolls explode.
• Movement Flow — If you do not take an Attack (A) action, you may freely pause and resume your Move (move ➔ pause ➔ move). Taking an Attack (A) concludes your movement if 1 or more MR has already been used.
• Difficult Terrain — Costs 2 Movement Rate 👣 points per square by default (3+ for severe obstacles).

Jumping Rules:
• Standing Jump (M Action) — Jump d👣 squares as a Move (M) action.
• Running Jump (AM Action) — Run up to MR 👣 on the ground plus leap d👣 squares as an Attack & Move (AM) action.
• Exploding d👣 Rolls — All d👣 rolls (both Jumps and Running) explode on their maximum face.

weapons.basics.title: Weapons & Combat Rules
weapons.basics.summary:
<!-- tab: ⚔️ Combat Rules -->
Rolls:
• Unskilled Attacks — Unknown weapons may be attempted as an Unskilled Attack (1d20 + Atk Die) with normal damage and Unskilled Block.
• Skilled Attacks — Known weapons use a Skilled Attack (2H20 + Atk Die) with normal damage and Skilled Block.
• Powers & Exotics — All Powers 🔥 and Exotics 🧿 are ALWAYS considered Skilled.

Action:
• Attack & Block Costs — Attacking is an Attack (A) action. Blocking is a Free (F) action.

Multi-Attacking:
• Single Weapon Example — With Might 💪 8 and a d4 Dagger, you can make 2 attacks (d4 + d4). With Might 💪 12, you can make 3 attacks (d4 + d4 + d4).
• Dual Wielding Example — With a d4 Dagger + d6 Shortsword (total d10), Might 💪 10 or 12 is required to make the multi-attack.
• Multi-Attack Rules — Roll a separate Attack and separate Dmg die for each strike. Strikes can target one foe or be split among adjacent foes.
• ⚠️ Uplifting Exception — Multi-attack damage dice are NEVER uplifted to your Attribute rating and stay at the weapon's requirement die.

Opportunity Attacks:
• Trigger Requirements — Engaged in melee, currently have Nish 🚩 over the opponent, and the opponent moves beyond your melee reach or performs a vulnerable non-melee action (casts a spell, drinks a potion, uses a ranged or hurled attack).
• Attack Resolution — Immediate Free (F) basic melee attack (1 per opponent per round; no Powers, Exotics, Focus, or Luck; exploding dice apply).

Blocking Melee:
• Requirements — Wielding a drawn melee weapon; monster attack is melee with incoming Dmg at or below the weapon's Max Block rating.
• Resolution — Success negates all damage. Failure means the hit connects and you roll Armor AR 🧥 to reduce damage.

<!-- tab: 🥋 Combat Styles -->
| Combat Style | Off-Hand | Key Rules & Utility Handling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 🗡️ Single Weapon (1H) | FREE | Emphasizes precision and Powers 🔥. Off-hand is free; utility tasks use a Partial (P) action. |
| 🗡️ Single Weapon (2H) | TIED UP | Both hands on weapon. Utility tasks require a Move (M) action (shift weapon to one hand). |
| ⚔️ Dual Wield | TIED UP | Hold two 1H weapons. Block using higher weapon Block cap. Utility tasks require a Move (M) action. |
| 🛡️ Weapon & Shield | TIED UP | Hold 1H weapon + Shield. Shield Block allowed. Utility tasks require a Move (M) action. |
| 🥊 Unarmed / Natural | FREE | Brawl & Throw Object. Cannot Block. Damage is -1d below governing Attribute (minimum d4). Utility tasks use a Partial (P) action. |

<!-- tab: 💥 Dmg Shift (Opt) -->
Heavy Weapon Shift (d6–d12 Dmg):
• Shift Atk ➔ Dmg — Shift excess Attack roll margin over target Defense into + Dmg.
• Max Shift by Base Die — d6: +1 | d8: +2 | d10: +3 | d12: +4 (d4 cannot shift Atk to Dmg).
• Example — With a d8 weapon, beating Defense by 1 adds +1 Dmg; beating by 2 or more adds +2 Dmg. Stacks with everything.

Reverse Finesse Shift (d4 Dmg ONLY):
• Shift Dmg ➔ Atk — When missing an Attack roll by up to 4 with a d4 weapon, call Dmg Shift to convert the miss into a hit.
• Damage Deduction — Subtract the miss shortfall directly from rolled Dmg (minimum 0 Dmg; if reduced to 0 or less, no wounds occur).

col.armor.ar.title: Armor & Defense Rules
col.armor.ar.summary:
Rolls:
• Unskilled Armor — Unknown armor may be attempted as an Unskilled Dodge (1d20 + d🏃) and normal AR 🧥.
• Skilled Armor — Known armor uses a Skilled Dodge (2H20 + d🏃) and normal AR 🧥.

Dodge vs. Block:
• Attack Evasion — All weapon attacks may be Dodged; melee (with weapon or shield) and ranged or hurled (with shield) may be Blocked instead if incoming Dmg is at or below Max Block.
• Exclusive Defenses — You may never both Block and Dodge the same attack.
• AR 🧥 Protection — If a Dodge or Block fails, your Armor's AR 🧥 is always rolled to reduce incoming Dmg.

Action & Requirements:
• Action Cost — All Dodge, Block, and Armor AR rolls are a Free (F) action.
• Unmet Requirements — Learning Armor below its Attribute requirement adds a +1 AP surcharge (refunded when met) and functions at your current stats.

col.shields.block.title: Shield & Block Rules
col.shields.block.summary:
Rolls & Action:
• Unskilled Shield Block — Unknown shields may be attempted as an Unskilled Block (1d20 + d💪).
• Skilled Shield Block — Known shields use a Skilled Block (2H20 + d💪).
• Action Cost — Blocking is a Free (F) action.

Blocking:
• Requirements — Wielding a drawn shield; incoming Dmg is at or below the shield's Max Block 🛡️ rating; applies to any melee, hurled, or shot weapon attack plus GM-approved blockable abilities.
• Resolution — Success negates all damage. Failure means the hit connects and you roll Armor AR 🧥 to reduce damage.

Shield-Hand & Movement Restrictions:
• Off-Hand Limits — Holding a shield ties up your off-hand (cannot hold a torch, lantern, flask, or second weapon in the shield hand).
• Utility Action Cost — Performing utility tasks during combat (drinking a potion, retrieving an item, opening a door) requires a Move (M) action while holding weapon and shield.
• Movement Rate (MR 👣) — Shield MR limits apply only while the shield is actively drawn and wielded.

skills.basics.title: Skill & Skill Set Rules
skills.basics.summary:
Rolls & Actions:
• Unskilled Checks — Any unknown skill (including weapons, armor, and shields) may be attempted as an Unskilled roll (1d20 + d(Atr)).
• Skilled Checks — Known skills, or skills matching a learned Skill Set, use a Skilled roll (2H20 + d(Atr)).
• Action Cost — Player-initiated skills use a Partial (P) or Free (F) action as determined by the GM. GM-requested checks (such as Awareness 👁️) are always Free (F).

Skill Sets & AP Costs:
• Individual Skills — 1 AP In-Path | 3 AP Universal (no GM approval) | 3 AP Out-of-Path (with GM approval).
• Skill Sets — 2 AP In-Path | 4 AP Out-of-Path (with GM approval). Grants Skilled proficiency across all member skills and related skills in the spirit of the set.
• Character Assists — When an ally helps with a skill task, the rolling hero gains Advantage at the GM's discretion.

powers.basics.title: Powers & Combat Rules
powers.basics.summary:
Core Power Rules:
• Always Skilled — Powers 🔥 including Exotics 🧿 Powers 🔥 are ALWAYS rolled as Skilled (2H20 + d(Atr)).
• Power Versions — Spend (Version # - 1) AP (with GM approval) to upgrade Die type, Target Count, Bonus, Affliction, Usage, or Range. Power Versions can NEVER modify a Power’s Action.

Exclusive Stacking Rule:
• Best Effect Wins — Bonuses or effects from Powers, Exotics, or Artifacts do not stack with each other; only the single best bonus/effect applies at any time.

Reading a Power:
• Usage Frequency (🔄) — 1-⚡ (1 Bolt = 5 Sparks; if an encounter ends at full Bolt, the Bolt and all Sparks are lost; otherwise current Sparks persist), 1-🍀 (1 Luck), 1-Enc, 2-Enc, 3-Enc, or 1-Rnd.
• Duration (⏳) — Instant, This Rnd, 1 Rnd (default if unstated), Encounter, or Next … (triggers on next specified roll or event).
• Range Bands (🎯) — Self, Touch, 1sq, 2sq, 3sq, Short (up to 6 sq), Medium (up to 12 sq), Long (up to 24 sq).

The Luck Twist (Rule of 1):
• Spend 1 Luck 🍀 — Apply a one-time boost to an activation: +1 Target, +1d Die Step, +1 Range Band, or +1 Push/Move square.

magic_items.basics.title: Exotics, Mods & Artifacts
magic_items.basics.summary:
Equipment & Mod Lineage:
• Exotics (🧿) — Any purchasable Gear ⚙️ chassis that has at least one Mod 🔌 (such as the free factory Inherent mod or a purchased aftermarket Mod).
• Artifacts (🔮) — Legendary or unique Exotic treasures (Cost = "Artifact") found through adventuring, loot drops, or Essence crafting.
• Physical Ownership Gate — To learn or use an Exotic Power 🔥, you must physically own the host Gear chassis (meaning it is either owned in your Gear ⚙️ Manager or selected and listed on your character sheet in the Weapons ⚔️, Armor 🧥, or Shields 🛡️ cards, regardless of whether Skilled or Unskilled) and have its parent Mod installed.

Learning & AP Refunds:
• 1 AP Learning Cost — Every Exotic Power 🔥 costs 1 AP to learn.
• Full AP Refund — Unlearning an Exotic Power, removing a Mod, or dropping/selling the host Gear immediately refunds 100% of invested AP.

gear.title: Standard Gear & Equipment Kits
gear.summary:
Gear & Kits Overview:
• Master Gear Category (⚙️) — Universal category for all physical items (Supplies 🎒, Weapons ⚔️, Armor 🧥, Shields 🛡️, Kits 📦, and Artifacts 🔮).
• Standard Gear (⚙️) — Mundane or tech equipment with no Exotic 🧿 mods, purchased with Gold and Silver (1g = 100s; new heroes start with 5g and 50s).
• Equipment Kits (📦) — Pre-assembled bundles of adventuring gear (Survival Kit, Trauma Kit, etc.) purchased for a flat Gold/Silver price.
• Zero Weight Math — SupaFlex uses no weight tracking or encumbrance movement penalties for carried gear.

chaos_gauntlet.basics.title: Chaos Gauntlet & Chaos Gems
chaos_gauntlet.basics.summary:
Core Mechanics:
• Gauntlet Slots — 6 Slots: 1 Wrist Mega Slot (👑) + 5 Finger Slots (🖐️).
• Gem Custody — Volatile crystallizations that cannot be carried loosely in packs; they only exist when socketed directly into a Chaos Gauntlet.
• Permanent Destruction on Removal — Removing a socketed gem from a gauntlet immediately shatters and destroys it.
• 3 Finite Uses — Socketed gems start with 3 uses and auto-shatter upon the 3rd use.
• Wrist Mega Slot Bolt Synergy — The Wrist Mega Slot can be activated by spending a Bolt (1-⚡ = 5 Sparks) without consuming any of the gem's 3 charges!
• Free Action (F) — Activating a Chaos Gem is a Free (F) action.

luck.basics.title: Luck Rules
luck.basics.summary:
Luck Pool & Recovery:
• Starting & Max Pool — Begin each Session with 3 Luck 🍀 (hard cap of 5 Luck).
• Earning Luck — Awarded by the GM during play for creative, entertaining, or heroic actions.

Spending Luck (1 🍀):
• Reroll Any Roll — Spend 1 Luck 🍀 to reroll any entire in-game roll and take the new result (a roll may only be lucked once).
• The Luck Twist (Rule of 1) — Spend 1 Luck 🍀 to apply an instant boost to an ability: +1 Target, +1d Die Step, +1 Range Band, or +1 Push/Move square.
• Activate Any Power (1/Enc) — Once per encounter, spend 1 Luck 🍀 to activate any known Power 🔥 (including Exotic 🧿 Powers 🔥), regardless of its Usage (1-🍀, 1-⚡, 1-Enc, 2-Enc, 3-Enc, or 1-Rnd).

sparks.basics.title: Bolt & Sparks Rules
sparks.basics.summary:
Earning Sparks & Building a Bolt:
• 5 Sparks = 1 Bolt (⚡) — Accumulating 5 Sparks builds a full Bolt (1-⚡) used to power high-impact 1-⚡ abilities.
• Tremendous or Critical Rolls — Gain +1 Spark for every natural 20 or natural 1 on the base d20 die of any ability roll.
• Exploding Dice — Gain +1 Spark per exploding die roll.

Full Bolt Bonus & Encounter End Rule:
• Full Bolt State (+1 All Rolls) — While holding a full Bolt (5 Sparks), gain +1 to all Attribute-derived rolls (including Defenses and Damage) until spent or the encounter ends.
• Encounter Persistence Rule — If an encounter ends with the character at full Bolt, then the Bolt and all Sparks are lost. Otherwise, the number of current Sparks persist into the next encounter.

powers.versions.title: Power Versions Rules
powers.versions.summary:
Creating & Learning a Power Version:
• Version AP Cost — Upgrading an existing Character 👤 or Exotic 🧿 Power 🔥 as a new Version costs (Version # - 1) AP (v2: (1 AP), v3: (2 AP), v4: (3 AP), etc.) and requires GM approval.
• Action Is Immutable — Power Versions can NEVER modify a Power’s Action (AM, A, M, P, F).

Allowed Version Upgrade Vectors (With GM Approval):
• Die Type — Upgrade damage, healing, or similar die type by +1d (d4 ➔ d6 ➔ d8 ➔ d10 ➔ d12).
• Target Count — Expand target count by +1.
• Bonus — Increase the bonus (typically by +1 or +2 per GM discretion).
• Affliction — Attach an Affliction on hit (Stunned, Prone, Weakened).
• Usage — Shift usage frequency (1-Enc ➔ 2-Enc ➔ 3-Enc). Rarely a GM may approve 1-⚡ ➔ 1-🍀, but almost never 1-🍀 ➔ 1-Enc or 3-Enc ➔ 1-Rnd.
• Range — Expand Range Band (Touch ➔ 1sq ➔ 2sq ➔ 3sq ➔ Short ➔ Medium ➔ Long) providing such a range shift makes sense.
